evidence: The interfacial reaction and structural properties studied by high-resolution x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HRXPS) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM). The depth profile of HRXPS, using synchrotron radiation beam and low-energy Ar + sputtering, exhibited no residual arsenic oxides at interface. The estimated deposition rate of roughly 0.084 nm per cycle was measured using a spectroscopic ellipsometer, x-ray reflectivity, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The TEM sample analytical work was performed using a Philips TECNAI-20 FEG type TEM. J-E and C-V characteristics were measured using Agilent 4156C and 4284, respectively. High-resolution x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HRXPS) using synchrotron radiation was performed to determine the chemistry at surface and bulk of the Al2O3 films and at the oxide/semiconductor interface.
